title: GOD, REMOVE THE LOAD THAT IS BREAKING MY STRENGTH
text: Beloved, before we go into the depths of this ministration, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this prayer. Share it with someone who is carrying a burden that is too heavy. Share it with that brother, that sister, that colleague, that family member who looks strong on the outside, but you know they are breaking on the inside. There is somebody in your contact list right now. The Holy Spirit is bringing their faith to your mind. They need this word. They need this prayer. Don't keep it to yourself. The kingdom of God advances through partnership, through compassion, through divine connections. Share this now. And as you do, the same burden you're carrying, God will send someone to help you carry it. That's the mystery of the kingdom. When you become a channel of blessing, you position yourself to receive. So, pause, share this, and let's go into the deep things of the [music] spirit. Now I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you're in your room, in your car, in your office, on the road, lift up your hands. The Bible says in Psalm 63:4, "Thus will I bless [music] thee while I leave. I will lift up my hands in thy name." There is something prophetic about the lifting of hands. It is a posture of surrender. It is a posture of expectation. It is a posture that says, "Lord, I cannot [music] carry this anymore. I am bringing it to you. You know there are loads in life that were never designed for human strength to carry. There are burdens that break the back that crush the spirit that destroy the vision that limits the potential. And many believers today are walking under weights that God never asked them to carry. Some of you have been carrying the weight of rejection for [music] 20 years. Some of you have been carrying the weight of failure, the weight of disappointment, the weight of shame, the weight of ancestral curses, the weight of demonic oppression, the weight of financial lack, the weight of barness, the weight of sickness, and you've been strong. You've been resilient. You've been fighting. But beloved, there comes a time when even the strongest warrior must say, "God, remove this load. It is breaking my strength." The Bible gives us a pattern in Matthew 11 28-30. Jesus stood and he made one of the most powerful invitations in all of scripture. He said, "Come unto me all ye that labor and are heavy laden and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn of me for I am meek and lowly in heart and ye shall find rest unto your souls. [music] For my yoke is easy and my burden is light. Listen to the language of the master. He said, "All ye that labor," that word labor in the Greek is copiao. It means to walk until you are exhausted, to toil until you are weary, to strive until your strength is depleted. Jesus is speaking to those who have been walking, fighting, struggling, striving, and yet the burden remains. He said, "All ye that are heavy laden," that word laden means to be weighed down, to be burdened, to carry something that is crushing you. And then he gives the invitation, "Come unto me." Not come unto religion, not come onto rituals, not come onto programs, come unto me, come unto the person, come onto the one who has power to remove what you cannot remove. There are three dimensions of loads that break human strength. And I want to address them. prophetically tonight. The first is the load of ancestral covenants and generational curses. The second is the load of personal sin, guilt, and shame. The third is the load of demonic assignments and satanic oppression. These three categories cover 90% of what is limiting the people of God today. And if the spirit of God will help me, I will show you from the scriptures how to be permanently [music] free. Let's talk about ancestral covenants. There are things happening in your life today that did not start with you. There are patterns of failure, patterns of limitation, patterns of tragedy that have been running in your family for generations. The Bible is very clear about this in Exodus 20:5. For I, the Lord thy God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me. This is not a popular teaching in the modern church because we want to believe that we're isolated islands that our lives began with us. But the Bible does not teach that. The Bible teaches that there is a spiritual lineage, a spiritual inheritance, a spiritual legacy that flows through bloodlines. Now, some of you are saying, "But pastor, I thought when I gave my life to Christ, all those things were broken." [music] Yes and no. Listen to me carefully. Positionally in Christ, you have been delivered from every curse. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law. Being made a curse for us positionally, legally, judicially, in the realm of the spirit, you are free." But experientially, many believers are still living under the influence of covenants they know nothing about. Why? Because deliverance is not automatic. Salvation is automatic. The moment you confess Jesus as Lord, you are saved. But deliverance requires knowledge. It requires confrontation. It requires warfare. I'll give you an example from scripture. In the book of Joshua chapter 7, Israel went to war against a [music] small city called a they had just defeated Jericho, a fortified city, a strong city, and now they were going against Ai, which was a smaller target. The Bible says they sent only 3,000 men because they underestimated the battle. And what happened? They were defeated. 36 men of Israel died. Joshua tore his clothes, fell on his face before the ark of the Lord. And he said, "Why did you bring us into this land to destroy us?" And God gave him a shocking answer. God said, "Israel has sinned and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them, for they have even taken of their costing." Now, here's what's powerful. Joshua didn't sin. The elders of Israel didn't sin. The soldiers who went to fight didn't sin. But there was one man named Achan who took the a costing and the whole nation suffered. That is the mystery of corporate sin. That is the mystery of ancestral covenant. One man's disobedience opened the door and an entire generation paid the price. How many of you know that there are things happening in your life today because of what your grandfather did? Because of what your grandmother did, because of altars that were raised, covenants that were made, sacrifices that were offered before you were even born. Some of you, every time you are about to make progress, something happens. Every time promotion is coming, there is an accident. Every time marriage is near, the relationship collapses. Every time the business is about to flourish, there is a crisis. And you keep wondering what is wrong with me? Am I cursed? Is there something I'm not doing right? And the answer is there is a load you are carrying from your lineage that you must confront. But I have good news for you tonight. The same Bible that reveals the problem also reveals the solution. In Jeremiah 31 29, the Bible says, "In those days they shall say no more. The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge. But everyone shall die for his own iniquity. Every man that eatth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge. God is saying there is coming a dispensation. There is coming a season where the course stops, where the pattern breaks, where the cycle ends, and that season is now. That season is tonight. I speak to every ancestral covenant working against your life be broken now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic altar speaking against your destiny be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every generational cause limiting your progress be revoked by the blood of Jesus. I declare tonight that you are the end of every evil pattern in your family. You are the beginning of a new story. You are the turnaround generation. Your children will not suffer what you suffered. Your lineage will not carry what your ancestors carried. This is your night of freedom. Let every [music] burden connected to your bloodline be lifted now in the name of Jesus. Now the second load I want to address is the load of personal sin, guilt and shame. This one is more common than we want to admit. Many believers are walking around with smiles on their faces but inside they are dying. Why? Because they are carrying guilt. They are carrying shame. They are carrying condemnation. They made a mistake 5 years ago, 10 years ago, 20 years ago, and they have never forgiven themselves. Every time they pray, the devil reminds them. Every time they try to believe God for something, the accuser brings up their past. Listen to me, beloved. The Bible says in Romans 8:1, "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the [music] spirit." Did you hear that? No condemnation. Not small condemnation. Not occasional condemnation. No condemnation. The moment you genuinely repent, the moment you confess your sin and turn away from it, God forgives you completely. He doesn't keep a record, he doesn't hold it over your head. He doesn't bring it up again. But the enemy does. Satan is called the accuser of the brethren. In Revelation 12:10, the Bible says, "The accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accuse them before our God day and night." That is his primary assignment to accuse you, to remind you, to make you feel unworthy, to make you feel disqualified, to make you feel like you can never be used by God again. Some of you aborted a child years ago and you have never forgiven yourself. Some of you committed adultery and even though you repented, you still feel dirty. Some of you stole money, destroyed a relationship, lied, cheated, betrayed someone and the guilt is eating you alive. And the enemy keeps telling you, you are finished. You are damaged goods. You are beyond redemption. That is a lie from the pit of hell. The Bible is full of people who failed massively but were restored completely. Moses was a murderer, but God used him to deliver Israel. David committed adultery and murder, but God called him a man after his own heart. Peter denied Jesus three times, but Jesus restored him and made him the leader of the early church. Paul persecuted Christians, killed them, imprisoned them, but Jesus appeared to him and made him the greatest apostle. If God can restore them, he can restore you. I want you to do something right now. I want you to close your eyes and I want you to bring that sin, that guilt, that shame, that mistake before the Lord. Don't hide it. Don't cover it. Bring it out. Confess it one more time. Say, "Lord, I did this. I failed you. I failed myself. But I am asking for mercy. I am asking for forgiveness. I am asking for restoration. And I want you to believe that in this moment by the power of the blood of Jesus, you are forgiven. Not partially, completely." The Bible says in 1 John 1:9, "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness." All unrighteousness. That includes your sin. That includes your mistake. That includes your failure. And now I speak a prophetic word over your life. Every load of guilt be lifted now in the name of Jesus. Every voice of condemnation be silenced now in the name of Jesus. Every memory that torments you be healed now by the power of the Holy Spirit. I declare that your past is buried in the sea of God's forgetfulness. I declare that you are a new creation. Old things are passed away. Behold, all things have become new. You are not defined by your worst moment. You are defined by the blood of Jesus. You are not what you did. You are who God says you are. You are forgiven. You are restored. You are qualified. You are anointed. You are chosen. You are loved. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. The third load I want to address is the load of demonic assignments and satanic oppression. This is a realm that many believers are ignorant of. And the Bible says in Hosea 4:6, "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge." There are people in this world, I'm not talking about fiction, I'm not talking about movies. I'm talking about real human beings who have sat in meetings where your name was mentioned. There are covens, there are shrines, there are altars, where witches and warlords gather and they mention names. They issue decrees. They release arrows. They send out spirits. And some of you have been under attack for years and you didn't even know it. The Bible is very clear that we are not fighting against flesh and blood. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. There is a kingdom of darkness. There is a hierarchy of demons. [music] And they have assignments. Some are assigned to destroy marriages. Some are assigned to block finances. Some are assigned to cause sickness. Some are assigned to bring confusion, depression and hopelessness. I want to tell you something that will shock you. Some of the problems you have been facing are not natural. They are not coincidental. They are not accidental. They are orchestrated. There is an intelligence behind them. There is a strategy behind them. The enemy studied you. He knows your weakness. He knows your vulnerabilities. He knows what hurts you, what discourages you, what makes you want to give up. And he has been hitting you in that area repeatedly, strategically, intentionally. But I have come tonight with a message from the throne room of heaven. The Bible says in 1 John 3:8, "For this purpose, the Son of God was manifested that he might destroy the works of the devil." Jesus did not come just to save you. He came to destroy the works of the enemy in your life. every plan, every plot, every scheme, every assignment, Jesus came to demolish it. In the book of Acts 10:38, the Bible says, "How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power, who went about doing good and healing all that were oppressed of the devil, for God was with him." Did you catch that? Jesus healed all that were oppressed of the devil. Not some, not a few, all. That means no matter what the enemy has done to you, no matter how long you've been under attack, no matter how severe the oppression is, Jesus has the power to set you free. Some of you have been dreaming terrible dreams. You see snakes. You see dead people. You see yourself in your old house. You see yourself eating in the dream. You see yourself in a wedding that you didn't plan. You see masquerades chasing you. Those are not ordinary dreams. Those are spiritual attacks. The enemy is trying to program failure into your life. He's trying to plant seeds of destruction in your subconscious. But tonight, we are going [music] to uproot every evil seed. We are going to cancel every [music] evil dream. We are going to reverse every demonic verdict. I want you to place your hand on your head right now. Wherever you are, place your hand on your head and I want you to pray with me. Pray with violence. Pray with authority. Pray with desperation. This is not time for religious prayer. This is time for militant prayer. Say every [music] demonic load upon my head, catch fire now in the [music] name of Jesus. Every burden assigned to break my strength be consumed now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every arrow fired into my destiny backfire now in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft covenant holding my life break now by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral altar speaking against me be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic decree over my life be revoked now in the name of Jesus. Every evil hand laid upon my head in the dream wither now in the name of Jesus. Every plantation of darkness in my body come out now with all your roots in the name of Jesus. Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, I divorce you now by fire in the name of Jesus. Every chain of limitation, break now in [music] the name of Jesus. Every cage holding my destiny, break open now in the name of Jesus. I speak to your finances right now. Every demonic embargo on your finances, be lifted now in the name of Jesus. Every hole in your pocket, be sealed now by the blood of Jesus. Every spirit of poverty leave my life now in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant draining my resources be broken now in the name of Jesus. I decree that money will locate you. Favor will surround you. Open doors will appear before you. Divine helpers will emerge for you. Your season of lack is over. Your season of abundance has begun. You will not beg for bread. You will not borrow to survive. You will lend to nations. You will be the head and not the tail. I speak to your health right now. Every sickness planted by witchcraft, die now in the name of Jesus. Every infirmity rooted in my family, be uprooted now in the name of Jesus. Every organ that is not functioning well, receive divine healing now in the name of Jesus. Every pain that defies medication, disappear now by the power of the Holy Ghost. I curse every spirit of death assigned against you. I decree that you will live and not die. You will declare the works of the Lord. Your days will be long upon the earth. No weapon fashioned against your health shall prosper. I speak to your marriage to your relationship right now. Every spirit of divorce leave now in the name of Jesus. Every third party agent of Satan be disgraced now in the name of Jesus. Every external interference in my marriage be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of misunderstanding, miscommunication, unforgiveness, I cast you out now in the name of Jesus. I decree that love will be restored. Peace will be restored. Joy will be restored. Unity will be restored. What God has joined together, no demon in hell can put us under. I speak to those believing God for the fruit of the womb. Every closed womb open now in the name of Jesus. Every fibroid, every cyst, every blockage dissolve now by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of barness, your time is up. I command you to leave now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic padlock on the womb break now in the name of Jesus. I decree that you will carry your child. You will nurse your baby. You will call yourself a mother. You will call yourself a father. Your season of mockery is over. Your season of testimony has begun. Now I want to show you something powerful from scripture. In the book of Isaiah 10 27, the Bible says, "And it shall come to pass in that day that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing." Did you catch that last phrase? The yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing. There is something about the anointing of God that destroys yolks. The anointing is not just for preaching. The anointing is not just for miracles. The anointing is a burden removing, yoke destroying power. When the anointing comes upon a man, upon a woman, things begin to change. Limitations begin to break. Barriers begin to fall. Mountains begin to move. The Bible says in Luke 4:18, "The spirit of the Lord is upon me because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor. He had sent me to [music] heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised." That is the ministry of the anointing, to heal, to deliver, to liberate, to restore. And tonight, I am releasing that anointing upon your life. I don't care how long you've been bound. I don't care how strong the enemy has been. I don't care what the doctor said. [music] I don't care what the prophets of doom said. When the anointing comes, everything changes. Chains break, doors open, miracles happen, impossibilities bow. Lift up your hands right now. Just lift them up. Don't analyze this. Don't intellectualize this. Just lift up your hands in surrender, in expectation, in faith. I decree that the anointing of the Holy Ghost is coming upon you right now. That anointing is touching your head. That anointing is flowing through your body. That anointing is destroying every yoke. That anointing is removing every burden. Every load you've been carrying, the anointing is taking it away. Every weight that has been crushing you, the anointing is lifting it off. You are being liberated. You are being delivered. You are being set free. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. There is a story in the Bible that ministers to me greatly whenever I think about burdens. Is the story of the woman with the issue of blood in Mark chapter 5. The Bible says she had been bleeding for 12 years. She had suffered many things from many physicians. She had spent all that she had and instead of getting better, she grew worse. 12 years of pain, 12 years of shame, 12 years of isolation. Because according to the law, she was unclean. She couldn't go to the temple. She couldn't touch anyone. She couldn't participate in public life. She was an outcast, a reject, a nobody. But one day she heard about Jesus. And something happened in her spirit. Faith was ignited. Hope [music] was rekindled. She said to herself, "If I may touch but his clothes, I shall behold." That is the language of desperation. That is the language of someone who has tried everything else and is now putting all their faith in one final attempt. And she pressed through the crowd. She fought through the obstacles. She ignored the voices that said, "You can't do this. You're unclean. You're not worthy." She reached out and she touched the hem of his garment. And immediately, the Bible says, her issue of blood dried up. 12 years of suffering ended in one moment. One touch, one encounter with Jesus. That is what I'm believing for you tonight. One encounter that will change everything. One touch that will end every battle. One moment that will shift your story from tragedy to testimony. You've been fighting for too long. You've been struggling for too long. You've been carrying this burden for too long. But tonight is your night. Tonight is your moment. Tonight is your season of divine intervention. The Bible says when the woman touched Jesus, virtue went out of him. That word virtue in the Greek is dunamis. It means power, ability, miraculous force. Jesus felt the power leave his body and go into that woman. And he turned around and said, "Who touched me?" The disciples were confused. They said, "Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, who touched me?" In other words, there are hundreds of people here. Everybody is touching you. Why are you asking who touched you? But Jesus knew the difference. There is a touch of curiosity and there is a touch of faith. There is a touch that is casual and there is a touch that is desperate. There is a touch that is religious and there is a touch that is relational. And Jesus said somebody had touched me for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me. He felt the transaction. He felt the transfer. He felt the power leave him and enter that woman. I want to ask you tonight, how are you touching Jesus? Are you touching him casually or are you touching him desperately? Are you just going through the motions of religion or are you genuinely reaching out in faith? Because your level of desperation determines your level of encounter. If you're not desperate, you won't press. If you're not hungry, you won't fight. If you're not convinced that this is your moment, you won't receive. But if you are desperate tonight, if you are tired of carrying this load, if you are exhausted from fighting this battle, if you are done with trying to fix this yourself, then reach out. Reach out with every ounce of faith you have. Reach out believing that the same Jesus who healed that woman is here right now. Reach out knowing that he's not limited by time. He's not limited by space. He's not limited by your location. Wherever you are, he's there. And if you will touch him in faith, virtue will flow into your life. Power will flow into your situation. Miracles will flow into your circumstances. Say this with me. Lord Jesus, I reach out to you right now. I touch you by faith. I believe that as I touch you, virtue is flowing into my life. Power is flowing into my situation. Healing is flowing into my body. Deliverance is flowing into my mind. Breakthrough is flowing into my finances. Restoration is flowing into my family. I receive my miracle now in the name of Jesus. Now, when the woman came forward trembling and fell at Jesus's feet, he said something beautiful to her. He said, "Daughter, be of good comfort. Thy faith hath made thee whole. Go in peace." He called her daughter. This woman who had been rejected by society, ostracized by the religious community, abandoned by everyone, Jesus called her daughter. He restored her identity. He restored her dignity. He restored her place in the community. And that is what God [music] is doing for you tonight. He's restoring your identity. He's restoring your dignity. He's restoring your place. Every label the enemy put on you, failure, rejected, cursed, finished, God is removing those labels tonight. And he's giving you new labels. Blessed, favored, chosen, anointed, victorious, successful, prosperous. You are not what the enemy said you are. You are who God says you are. And God says you are his child, his son, his daughter, his beloved, his anointed, his chosen vessel. I declare over your life tonight, you are a carrier of glory. You are a vessel of honor. You are a candidate for miracles. You are a magnet for favor. You are a threat to the kingdom of darkness. You are a solution to your generation. You are a history maker. You are a record breaker. You are a barrier breaker. You are a yoke destroyer. The load is being lifted. The burden is being removed. The chains are being broken. The doors are being opened. The walls are coming down. The mountains are being moved. You are entering your season of acceleration. Things that took or others 20 years will take you 2 years. Things that took orders 10 years will take you one year. You are entering your suddenly season. Suddenly the breakthrough comes. Suddenly the miracle happens. Suddenly the door opens. Suddenly the favor appears. This is your time. Let me take you to one more scripture before we close this ministry. In the book of Zechariah chapter 3, we find the story of Joshua the high priest. The Bible says he was standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan was standing at his right hand to resist him. Joshua was dressed in filthy garments symbolic of sin, symbolic of shame, symbolic of unworthiness and Satan was there accusing him, reminding him of his failures, telling him he was not qualified to be the high priest. But the Lord said to Satan, "The Lord rebuked thee, oh [music] Satan. Even the Lord that had chosen Jerusalem rebuked thee. Is not this a brand plot out of the fire?" And then God gave a command to the angel standing there. He said, "Take away the filthy garments from him, and unto Joshua said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will cloth thee with change of raignment." They removed the filthy garments, and cloth him with rich apparel. They put a clean miter upon his head. Do you see the picture? God removed what was dishonorable and clo Joshua with what was honorable. God removed what represented failure and clothe him with what represented success. God removed what represented shame and clothe him with what represented glory. And that is what God is doing for you tonight. He's removing the old. He's removing the shame. He's removing the failure. He's removing the curse and he's clothing you with newness. [music] He's clothing you with honor. He's clothing you with glory. He's clothing you with anointing. Every filthy garment the enemy put on you be removed now in the name of Jesus. Every garment of poverty be removed now. Every garment of sickness be removed now. Every garment of barness be removed now. Every garment of failure be removed now. every garment of shame be removed now. And I decree that God is clothing you with garments of praise, garments of glory, garments of honor, garments of favor, garments of success, garments of abundance, garments of divine health, garments of wholeness. Receive your new garments now in the name of Jesus. You know, I want to close with this. There is a principle in the kingdom that many believers don't understand. is called the principle of exchange. God operates by exchange. He takes what is broken and gives what is whole. He takes what is weak and gives what is strong. He takes what is heavy and gives what is light. That is why Jesus said in Matthew 11, take my yoke upon you. He didn't say I will remove your yoke and leave you without any yoke. He said take my yoke. There is an exchange. You give him your burden and he gives you his rest. You give him your weakness and he gives you [music] his strength. You give him your failure and he gives you his success. But for the exchange to happen, you must be willing to let go. Some of you have been holding on to your burden so tightly that you can't receive what God wants to give you. You're holding on to your guilt. You're holding on to your shame. You're holding on to your pain. You're holding on to your fear. And God is saying, "Let it go. Release it. Give it to me. I'm ready to give you something better. Right now, I want you to make a declaration of release. Open your mouth and say it out loud. Say, "I let go of every burden. I let go of every weight. I let go of every load. I let go of guilt. I let go of shame. I let go of fear. I let go of pain. I let go of failure. I let go of disappointment. I release it all into the hands of Jesus. And I receive his peace. I receive his rest. I receive his strength. I receive his joy. I receive his anointing. I receive his favor. I receive his breakthrough. I receive my miracle now in the mighty name of Jesus. As we conclude, I want to pray one final prayer over your life. And I want you to receive this prayer with every fiber of your being. Don't just listen to it. Receive it. Agree with it. Believe it. Let faith rise in your heart as I speak. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus. I come before you on behalf of every person reading this word, listening to this voice. Lord, you see them. You know them by name. You know their struggles. You know their pain. You know their burdens. You know what they've been carrying. You know what's been breaking their strength. And tonight, by the authority of heaven, I command every load to be lifted. I command every burden to be removed. I command every yoke to be destroyed. I decree that the anointing of the Holy Ghost is resting upon them. That anointing is breaking chains. That anointing is opening doors. That anointing is releasing miracles. That anointing is reversing curses. That anointing is restoring destinies. I speak to every ancestral covenant working against their lives. Be broken now by the blood of Jesus. I speak to every demonic assignment be frustrated now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every witchcraft operation be scattered now by fire. I speak to every evil altar be destroyed now. I speak to every spiritual cage break open [music] now. I speak to every closed door open now. I speak to every mountain be removed now. I speak to every valley be lifted now. I speak to every crooked place be made straight now. Lord, I declare that this is their season of divine acceleration. This is their season of supernatural breakthrough. This is their season of uncommon favor. This is their season of unprecedented miracles. What they've been waiting for, let it come now. What they've been believing for, let it manifest now. What they've been praying for, let it happen now. No more delays, no more denials, no more disappointments. This is their time. This is their moment. This is their season. In the mighty name of Jesus, I seal this prayer and I declare that it is done. Amen and amen. Now, before you go, I want you to do something. I want you to thank God not because you see it yet, not because you feel it yet, but because you believe it. Thanksgiving is an act of faith. When you thank God before the manifestation, you are saying, "I believe it's already done." So, lift up your hands one more time and just begin to thank him. Say, "Thank you, Jesus. Thank you for removing my load. Thank you for lifting my burden. Thank you for destroying every yoke. Thank you for my breakthrough. Thank you for my miracle. Thank you for my deliverance. Thank you for my healing. Thank you for my restoration. Thank you that I am free. Thank you that I am whole. Thank you that I am victorious in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Go in peace belove. The load is gone. The burden is lifted. The yoke is destroyed. You are free. You are whole. You are victorious.
